messages:
carla-cs: Quick heads-up — Greenleaf Bank submitted a bespoke SIG/CAIQ focused on KMS + HSM evidence. They want audit logs, key rotation proof, and an HSM attestation. Due in 72h. Also flagged: intermittent 401s this morning and a sudden billing jump (large embedding job). Putting this in here so we can coordinate.
ryan-eng: Can you paste the 401 error sample and timestamps? I can check routing + auth headers. Any repro steps from them?
carla-cs: Snippet they sent below. Happened at 2026-03-16T09:14:22Z and 09:18:10Z. Customer says it was from a service account that normally works.
carla-cs: ```json
{"time":"2026-03-16T09:14:22Z","status":401,"error":"Unauthorized","request_id":"req_0a1b2c","ip":"34.12.5.6","msg":"missing required header: x-api-key"}
```
ryan-eng: Looks like missing header on our side or an SDK bug that strips apiKey on long-lived connections. Repro-bot: can you provide a minimal curl to reproduce auth and a tcpdump command to capture headers?
repro-bot: ```bash
# quick curl reproduce
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/outputs -d '{"input":"hi"}'

# tcpdump (pls run on client's proxy/debug host):
sudo tcpdump -i any -s 0 -w capture.pcap port 443 and host api.redwood.ai
```
mike-security: For the SIG evidence: we can provide:
- Audit log export (signed S3 export covering last 12 months)
- KMS key metadata (rotation schedule, key creation/disable dates)
- HSM attestation summary (if they require FIPS/HSM vendor certs we need to escalate to compliance and partner team)

What exact artifacts do they want? Does the bespoke form ask for KMS CMK ARNs and export of envelope keys? Need clarity before we produce anything.
carla-cs: Customer checklist attached in their email: "export of admin/audit logs for tenant ID GFB-788, KMS key rotation CSV for keys used in last 18 months, HSM vendor certs, and signed statement of non-exportability." They also asked for timezone-normalized timestamps.
mike-security: Ok. Action plan: I will assemble an evidence package with metadata + signed manifest. Privacy/compliance will review HSM attestation language. @tess-legal can you confirm if signed attestation meets contract terms or if we need an NDA amendment for deeper vendor paperwork?
tess-legal: I can review. If they request vendor-signed HSM hardware statements, we may need a quick addendum. Offer them a 2-week extension as an option while we gather vendor docs. Also recommend we redact any customer PII from logs before export.
carla-cs: Please also include a billing breakdown. Customer reports a spike at 09:10-09:20. billing-bot can you pull token-usage for tenant GFB-788 around that window?
billing-bot: GFB-788 usage summary (2026-03-16 09:00-09:30 UTC): total tokens 7.2M, embeddings 5.9M (batch job), generation tokens 1.3M. Cost jump due to embeddings job with large batch size (no batching cap). I'll attach per-route breakdown to the ticket.
ryan-eng: On the latency/auth side — I checked routing logs: those IPs were hitting the eu-west-1 dedicated pool we host for Greenleaf. We had a transient autoscaler glitch at 09:12 where one worker misreported health and caused some connections to be proxied through a longer path -> higher latency and dropped headers on reconnect. I can flip their routing policy to hosted pool while we patch. That should stop 401s immediately if it's header-drop on reconnect.
carla-cs: Do it please. I'll tell the customer we can temporarily route them to hosted API and share an evidence timeline + billing breakdown. Also requesting 72h extension.
mike-security: I'll start packaging audit logs. Note: exports take ~30-45m for full tenant month. I'll provide SHA256 manifests and signed S3 links. For KMS rotation CSV: format I'll produce is: `key_id,created_at,last_rotated,rotation_policy`.
carla-cs: Perfect. Once we have all artifacts, I'll upload to the secure bucket and share a one-time link with Greenleaf. Action items:
- ryan-eng: implement temporary routing change + confirm in thread
- mike-security: audit logs + KMS CSV + attestation draft
- tess-legal: review attestation + advise on extension language
- billing-bot: attach cost breakdown & recommended mitigation (batch-size cap)

carla-cs: Update — routing flipped at 2026-03-16T10:02Z, customer reports reduced errors. I'll open INC-2026-459 to track evidence delivery. \:white_check_mark:
